name: hermes-whale-widget-dev
description: Dev scaffold for the hermes-whale-widget plugin (NOT published; the plugin artifact is desktop/plugin.js).

comments.esbuild: AGENTS.md §10 dependency justification: Hermes has no official bundler; the runtime-loader accepts ONLY a single-file ESM with a strict import whitelist (@hermes/plugin-sdk + react*), so esbuild is required to produce desktop/plugin.js from desktop/src/.
comments.react: Intentionally NOT a plugin dependency: react and @hermes/plugin-sdk are runtime-provided by Hermes and stay external in the bundle. The react/react-dom copies here are dev-preview/test shims only (tools/dev-preview.mjs bundles them into the preview page; they never enter the artifact).
